notes.title: Issue fixes
notes.content:
Hello, President!
We have updated the bug fixes.

Patch Note

Fixed the following issues.
・BGM during Defense battles not running properly.
・If a quotation mark is included in the user directory folder the game won't run.
・Changing tabs after watching a scenario in the dictionary a bug occurs.
・If you open the menu at the end of your turn the menu can't be closed until the end of enemy's turn.

Increased stability under certain circumstances.
・During tutorials.
・Issue that happens after ending battle.
・After returning from an exploration.
・When the dialogue screen is open at recruitment and shop.
